Maya Chen: Heads up — planning a 60m enablement office hours focused on onboarding flows and renewal playbook for APAC/EMEA customers. Looking at Wed Apr 14 or Thu Apr 15. Who can lead the session and what slots work? cc @Tomas @Priya
Tomas Alvarez: I can cover onboarding checklist + demo. Prefer Thu 03:00–04:00 SGT (Wed 20:00–21:00 UTC).
Priya Singh: Can handle renewal risks + Q&A. Thu SGT slot works for me too. :thumbsup:
Benji Li: I'm oncall those days but can do Wed 11:00–12:00 PST (Thu 02:00 SGT) — that's earlier for APAC.
Alex Park: Would prefer Thu SGT slot as well. Also can make a short slide deck, will drop draft in drive.
Maya Chen: OK consensus toward Thu Apr 15 02:00–03:00 SGT / Wed Apr 14 18:00–19:00 UTC. Proposed agenda: 1) 10m intros, 2) 20m onboarding demo, 3) 20m renewal playbook & Qs, 4) 10m open office hours. Any changes?
Priya Singh: Add a 5m 'how to raise support / eval regression' bit.
Maya Chen: Good — adding that. Quick poll: who can host recording + notes? @Alex @Benji
Alex Park: I'll do recording + notes. Will upload to drive and post summary.
cs_bot: Calendar event created: https://cal.com/redwood/apac-enable-2026 — invites will go to customer aliases. (automated)
Maya Chen: I'll email customers with optional pre-read and ask for top three questions. Draft here: https://tinyurl.com/rw-apac-preread
Tomas Alvarez: Can we add a short live eval walkthrough? 5–7m with prompt examples.
Maya Chen: Yep, slotting 7m. Final agenda updated in drive. Thanks team :rocket:
